title: Renormalized Retained-Pair Transport Derivation
starting_point: V1695.6 showed that local pair-labeled product curvature survives, but cross-scale transport failed because the coarse-to-fine map was underived.
claim_boundary: Mathematical derivation protocol only. No execution, no compatibility claim, no retained field-law validation.

discarded_as_evidence.reason: failed cross-scale alignment and did not derive retained-pair aggregation.

core_object.direction: fine retained-pair space -> coarse retained-pair space
core_object.meaning: aggregates fine retained product-pair covectors into coarse retained product-pair covectors while preserving admissible pair labels/orientation.

coarse_pair_definition.description: A coarse retained pair is not nearest-cell matched; it is an aggregation of fine retained pairs inside the coarse block.
coarse_pair_definition.weights: α_a are admissibility weights from retained support, provenance orientation, and product contribution.
coarse_pair_definition.normalization: scale normalization must preserve pair Gram energy or declared invariant norm.

transport_operator.T_pair: component map from fine pair label a to coarse pair label A
transport_operator.orientation: signed orientation from Π must be retained
admissibility: fine pair belongs to coarse support block
orientation is preserved or explicitly signed
pair contribution weight is declared before invariant evaluation
normalization is independent of null outcomes

scale_normalized_gram.claim_boundary: Only a transport diagnostic. Not a field law.

conservation_condition.statement: renormalized pair transport is admissible only if aggregate pair Gram energy is approximately conserved under declared normalization.
conservation_condition.meaning: prevents arbitrary matching or post-hoc rescaling.

killer_nulls.N_local_signature_preserved_aggregation_: preserve local pair signatures but randomize block aggregation; must fail.
killer_nulls.N_orientation_drop: drop Π sign/orientation in R_pair; must fail.
killer_nulls.N_weight_shuffle: shuffle α weights across fine pairs while preserving distribution; must fail.
killer_nulls.N_nearest_cell_transport: use old nearest-cell transport; must fail or be clearly weaker.
killer_nulls.N_scale_scramble: preserve local signatures but scramble cross-scale covariance; must fail.
